requirements: R1: Dedicated structure and explicit management for raw epidemiological data/datasets distinct from documents and protocols

slices.title: Patch existing entities to support explicit data management
slices.jtbd: When implementing raw data management for this epic, I want to patch the existing backend codebase directly, so that data sets can be managed alongside protocols without creating new distinct UI or API boundaries.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the 'База знаний по эпидемиологии' backend service,
When managing records via existing endpoints,
Then the system must support explicit properties or types to manage raw datasets, and these changes must be verifiable by passing unit and integration tests.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Record type flexibility in the backend
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease instances of raw data miscategorization from 100% to 0%

requirements: R1: Replace in-memory user details with database-backed authentication

slices.title: Patch SecurityConfig for database-backed authentication
slices.jtbd: When implementing the persistent authentication for this epic, I want to replace the InMemoryUserDetailsManager with a database-backed mechanism in the existing codebase, so that authentication is secure and production-ready.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a deployed Spring backend system,
When a user attempts to access the knowledge base endpoints,
Then authentication must be verified against a persistent database rather than in-memory credentials, explicitly returning 401 Unauthorized for invalid credentials and verifiable by passing unit and integration tests.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Hardcoded security constraints in the application startup
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce hardcoded credential vulnerabilities from 1 to 0
